Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-identity-fact

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-identity-fact defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
provider-comparison Provider comparisonThe outcome of the selected provider comparison context; this code alone establishes no result or End-versus-Start mismatch.
client-comparison Client comparisonThe outcome of the selected client comparison context; this code alone establishes no result or presence.
source-status Source statusOriginal supported source status string for this selected result, preserved without treating a backend label as sufficient evidence for a governed outcome.
outcome-basis Outcome basisWhether the selected source status was explicitly reported by its producer or derived from other supported facts; does not establish that a derived status proves a particular outcome.
source-reason Source reasonOriginal supported reason string associated with this selected source status; not a newly governed outcome code.
comparison-context Comparison contextOriginal supported comparison-context string distinguishing the selected check, such as Start, End or join; not a whole-session aggregation.
threshold-policy-version Threshold policy versionRecorded threshold-policy version associated with this source result; not a threshold, score or current-policy substitution.
biometric-model-version Biometric model versionRecorded biometric-model version associated with this source result. Does not alone prove that the comparator executed that model; disclose a template-only association when applicable.
